fields.label: --max-turns
fields.description: Caps the agentic turns of a review. Empty or 0 leaves the CLI default.

fields.label: --effort
fields.description:
How much compute Claude uses.
low = quick scan · medium = balanced · high = thorough · max = exhaustive.
Higher effort improves quality but increases cost and latency.

fields.label: --permission-mode
fields.description:
Controls how Claude handles tool permissions.
default: standard prompts · auto: minimal prompts · acceptEdits: auto-accept file edits · dontAsk: never ask.

fields.label: --bare
fields.description:
Minimal mode: disables auto-memory, hooks, LSP, plugins and CLAUDE.md discovery.
Faster and more predictable for automated reviews.

fields.label: --no-session-persistence
fields.description:
Disables saving sessions to disk.
Keeps automated reviews clean and isolated — prevents session accumulation over time.

fields.label: --dangerously-skip-permissions
fields.description:
⚠️ Bypasses ALL permission checks.
This screen can only disable it. To enable it, edit config.toml directly in a sandboxed or trusted environment.
